dependencies.note: The Worker installs these dependencies before execution. Configure a source in System Settings; administrators can pre-populate a source or cache for offline and enterprise networks. An empty list skips the dependency check and missing packages may fail at runtime.

reasons.runningSave: Stop the current run before saving

settings.title: Task runtime settings
settings.workerPlaceholder: Select a Runtime Worker that supports the current language

settings.invalidScheduleInput: Schedule Input must be valid JSON
settings.savedScheduleNotLoaded: Runtime configuration was saved, but Schedule has not finished loading (or failed to load), so schedule fields were not saved. Refresh and try again.

settings.noCredential: No token Credentials are available. Create one in System Settings first.
settings.workerPlaceholder: Select a Runtime Worker that supports the current language
settings.timeoutHint: When a call exceeds this duration, the system ends it and marks it as “timeout”.
settings.copy: Webhook address copied to the clipboard.
